caption: The drawing features a full-length dress depicted in pencil on a beige or off-white background. The dress has a high, ruffled neckline and long sleeves that are adorned with parallel ruffled trims running from the shoulder to the wrist, ending with a ruffled cuff. The bodice is fitted at the waist with a circular, decorated belt. The skirt is voluminous and flares out from the waist, decorated with multiple horizontal bands of ruffles, particularly concentrated on the lower portion and hem of the skirt. The main view shows the front of the dress, while a smaller, secondary sketch in the upper right corner illustrates the back of the dress. At the back, the dress features a row of buttons extending from the collar to the waist, and the skirt gathers into gentle pleats, echoing the ruffled trimming found at the front. The entire sketch is monochromatic, with fine outlines and shading to suggest the texture and layering of the fabric. There are no additional colors, objects, or backgrounds present in the composition.
title: Wedding Dress
